prompt: How many letters long is the title of the first movie composed by the composer of the first American Godzilla movie?
answer:
The first American *Godzilla* movie was composed by **David Arnold**. His first film was **_The Young Americans_**.

**“The Young Americans” has 18 letters** (excluding spaces).
